name: Dry season
effects: flood states low, dry-haze enabled, some shallow crossings open, peat-fire risk, overland travel favoured

name: Hatching turn
effects: transition weeks: giant-snake and insect breeding hazards spike (Tips for Black Marsh Travel); guides advise against deep travel

name: Wet season
effects: flood states high, monsoon/storm weights x2, insect hatching peaks (travel-advice hazard calendar), boats favoured
